Resolved H2 I/O representation retains kind/message. Control deliberately asserts typed H2/I/O kind and literal message, not preservation of arbitrary upstream custom payload.

Every task owner is retained across exchange; explicit normal-path stop/join runs, while exceptional futures retain Drop abort responsibility. Observations and preparation are bounded by existing deadlines.
